Oled Display Module.name: Glass
Oled Display Module.reasoning: Glass acts as the substrate providing mechanical support and optical clarity for the OLED layers, universally used in rigid OLED displays.

Oled Display Module.name: Indium
Oled Display Module.reasoning: Indium is a key element in indium tin oxide (ITO) which serves as a transparent conductive layer essential for OLED operation; industry standard with rare substitutes.

Oled Display Module.name: Silver
Oled Display Module.reasoning: Silver is often used as a cathode electrode material in OLEDs, though aluminum and others can substitute, so confidence is moderate.

Lithium-ion Battery Pack.name: Lithium
Lithium-ion Battery Pack.reasoning: Lithium is the fundamental element for lithium-ion chemistry, absolutely required for energy storage with no viable alternatives at scale.

Lithium-ion Battery Pack.name: Cobalt
Lithium-ion Battery Pack.reasoning: Cobalt is used in the cathode to provide stability and energy density, standard in NMC chemistry though substitutes like iron phosphate exist.

Lithium-ion Battery Pack.name: Nickel
Lithium-ion Battery Pack.reasoning: Nickel enhances energy density in cathode materials, commonly used though ratios vary and alternatives exist.

Lithium-ion Battery Pack.name: Copper
Lithium-ion Battery Pack.reasoning: Copper serves as the key electrical conductor for current collectors and wiring universally in battery packs.

Lithium-ion Battery Pack.name: Aluminum
Lithium-ion Battery Pack.reasoning: Aluminum is used for cathode current collectors and casing, standard although some designs use steel alternatives.

Lithium-ion Battery Pack.name: Graphite
Lithium-ion Battery Pack.reasoning: Graphite is the primary anode material allowing lithium ion intercalation, universally used in commercial lithium-ion batteries.

Chassis.name: Steel Ingots

Chassis.name: Glass

Speaker Module.name: Copper

Speaker Module.name: Neodymium
Speaker Module.reasoning: Neodymium is the typical rare earth magnet material in speakers for strong magnetic fields; standard with only a few magnets as substitutes.

Speaker Module.name: Iron
Speaker Module.reasoning: Iron is used in the magnetic core and structural parts of speakers, common though substitutes with other ferrous metals exist.
